overall_rationale: The strongest designs isolate the concept being taught, give it meaningful canvas occupancy, and replace dense inline labels with numbered markers plus a compact legend when space is constrained. Full-system context often becomes too faint to teach from, while label-led versions that are acceptable on desktop frequently collide or clip at 844x390 and 390x844. Desktop ties reflect genuinely equivalent renderings rather than withheld judgments.
